_comment: Single source of project-specific values for the vibe-governance-kit harness. Edit THIS file per project — the hooks read it; you should not need to edit the Python. See README.md §Adopt.

dangerousCommands.comment: Blocks destructive Bash via PreToolUse. Built-in patterns (rm -rf, force push, fork bomb, mkfs, etc.) always apply. Add project-specific ones here.

secretScan.comment: Last-line secret scan before a file hits disk. Built-in patterns (AWS keys, JWT, private keys, generic password/api_key) always apply. Toggle locale presets and add your own.

boundaries.comment: Branch->path ownership enforcement. OFF by default. Turn on for multi-agent / multi-owner repos. mode 'soft' warns on unknown branches; 'strict' denies.

prePush.comment: Blocks `git push` when the local branch is behind origin/<target> (prevents stale/diverged pushes). Force pushes are handled by dangerousCommands.

format.comment: PostToolUse auto-format. Silently skips any formatter that is not installed.

sessionStart.comment: Injects repo state (branch, divergence, uncommitted, recent commits, open PRs) into the session. host: github | gitlab | none.
